text:
maria-support: Customer #3921 hit a sudden spike in 5xxs and billing after upgrading SDKs ~2h ago. They upgraded both TS and Python to v1.16.0 and saw multiple duplicate requests and higher token counts. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/3921

alex-devex: Can you paste their root request + headers and SDK versions? Need a repro or quick mitigation.

maria-support: Here is the curl they captured:

```
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-std-1\",\"prompt\":\"hi\",\"max_tokens\":64}'
```

maria-support: Logs show the same client request-id retried 3-4x within a second. Gateway returned 504s and tokens were billed per attempt.

sam-sdk: I scanned the regen: the new OpenAPI extension `x-client-defaults` was added and our generator mapped `autoRetry` default -> true for TS/Py. Go still has default=false. That explains the asymmetric behavior.

tia-ml: Retries can easily multiply billable tokens. If each retry reaches the token accounting point it will count. Also retries can exacerbate backend load and cause more 504s.

alex-devex: Is there a quick toggle we can tell the customer to set?

sam-sdk: Yes, clients respect env var REDWOOD_CLIENT_AUTORETRY=false to disable client-side auto loops. Repro locally for TS:

```
export REDWOOD_CLIENT_AUTORETRY=false
node example.js
```
And for Python:

```
export REDWOOD_CLIENT_AUTORETRY=false
python app.py
```

maria-support: Customer tried that and their error rate dropped back to baseline, billing normalized. They want root cause + patch timeline.

jon-eng-ci: Action plan: 1) backport hotfix for codegen to ensure default autoRetry=false; 2) cut client patch releases (v1.16.1) for TS and Py with explicit default=false; 3) add changelog note and KB article about billing risk from client retries.

sam-sdk: I will cut TS/Py v1.16.1 patches today and add notes. Also adding a stricter parser for `x-client-defaults` so missing keys do not default to true.

alex-devex: We should also add a CI parity test in regen pipeline to detect different default config across SDKs.

tia-ml: I can scan recent regen diffs for other implicit defaults (timeouts, maxRetries, followRedirects) and post results here.

jon-eng-ci: For Dedicated tenants, long term we can add an edge policy to ignore client retry hints if tenants opt out. Short-term: publish client patches.

sam-sdk: Opening PR for regen CI parity test now. Also will add test that generates clients and compares a golden defaults file.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: ts@canary in 30m, py@canary in 45m. Will report 504 and token metrics to #eng-sre.

maria-support: Updated ticket #3921 with mitigation and ETA. Customer asked to be pinged when patches are published.

alex-devex: Thanks everyone. If anyone finds other regen diffs (param renames, header shape changes) call them out.

maria-support: Closing loop here until patches are out; will post customer confirmation once they validate upgrades.
